module.Title: Skip Offline Sensors
module.Teaching: continue skips the rest of the current iteration and moves to the next item.
module.PredictionQuestion: What happens to an offline sensor?
PredictionOptions: It is skipped and the loop checks the next sensor
module.PredictionExplanation: continue bypasses the remaining lines for that one sensor.
module.DebugPrompt: break would stop checking all remaining sensors.
module.RecallPrompt: Write the offline-sensor skip logic from memory. Use these exact identifiers: print, sensors. Use these exact values: False, "name", "online".
module.TransferPrompt: Skip readings equal to -1 while printing valid values. Use these exact identifiers: print, reading.
module.PreviewMessage: The monitoring routine can ignore unavailable devices.
